options.name: dragon_slay_check
options.description: If true, slaying each dragon for the first time is a check

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: bat_logic
options.description:
How the bat is considered for logic

With cannot_break, the bat cannot pick up an item that starts out-of-logic until the player touches it
With can_break, the bat is free to pick up any items, even if they are out-of-logic
With use_logic, the bat can pick up anything just like can_break, and locations are no longer considered to require
  the magnet or bridge to collect, since the bat can retrieve these.
A future option may allow the bat itself to be placed as an item.

Supported values: cannot_break, can_break, use_logic
Default value: can_break

options.name: freeincarnate_max
options.description:
How many maximum freeincarnate items to allow

When done generating items, any remaining item slots will be filled
with freeincarnates, up to this maximum amount.  Any remaining item
slots after that will be 'nothing' items placed locally, so in multigame
multiworlds, keeping this value high will allow more items from other games
into Adventure.

options.name: dragon_rando_type
options.description:
How to randomize the dragon starting locations

normal: Grundle is in the overworld, Yorgle in the white castle, and Rhindle in the black castle
shuffle: A random dragon is placed in the overworld, one in the white castle, and one in the black castle
overworldplus: Dragons can be placed anywhere, but at least one will be in the overworld
randomized: Dragons can be anywhere except the credits room


Supported values: normal, shuffle, overworldplus, randomized
Default value: shuffle

options.name: connector_multi_slot
options.description:
If true, the client and lua connector will add lowest 8 bits of the player slot
to the port number used to connect to each other, to simplify connecting multiple local
clients to local EmuHawk instances.
Set in the yaml, since the connector has to read this out of the rom file before connecting.

options.name: yorgle_speed
options.description:
Sets Yorgle's initial speed.  Yorgle has a speed of 2 in the original game
Default value: 2

options.name: yorgle_min_speed
options.description:
Sets Yorgle's speed when all speed reducers are found.  Yorgle has a speed of 2 in the original game
Default value: 2

options.name: grundle_speed
options.description:
Sets Grundle's initial speed.  Grundle has a speed of 2 in the original game
Default value: 2

options.name: grundle_min_speed
options.description:
Sets Grundle's speed when all speed reducers are found.  Grundle has a speed of 2 in the original game
Default value: 2

options.name: rhindle_speed
options.description:
Sets Rhindle's initial speed.  Rhindle has a speed of 3 in the original game
Default value: 3

options.name: rhindle_min_speed
options.description:
Sets Rhindle's speed when all speed reducers are found.  Rhindle has a speed of 3 in the original game
Default value: 2

options.name: difficulty_switch_a
options.description:
Set availability of left difficulty switch
This controls the speed of the dragons' bite animation

options.name: difficulty_switch_b
options.description:
Set availability of right difficulty switch
On hard, dragons will run away from the sword

options.name: start_castle
options.description:
Choose or randomize which castle to start in front of.

This affects both normal start and reincarnation.  Starting
at the black castle may give easy dot runs, while starting
at the white castle may make them more dangerous!  Also, not
starting at the yellow castle can make delivering the chalice
with a full inventory slightly less trivial.

This doesn't affect logic since all the castles are reachable
from each other.

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: death_link_amnesty
options.description:
Amount of forgiven deaths before sending a Death Link.
0 means that every death will send a Death Link.

options.name: dw_death_link_amnesty
options.description: Amount of forgiven deaths before sending a Death Link during Death Wish levels.

options.name: EndGoal
options.description:
The end goal required to beat the game.
Finale: Reach Time's End and beat Mustache Girl. The Finale will be in its vanilla location.

Rush Hour: Reach and complete Rush Hour. The level will be in its vanilla location and Chapter 7
will be the final chapter. You also must find Nyakuza Metro itself and complete all of its levels.
Requires DLC2 content to be enabled.

Seal the Deal: Reach and complete the Seal the Deal death wish main objective.
Requires Death Wish content to be enabled.

options.name: ShuffleStorybookPages
options.description:
If enabled, each storybook page in the purple Time Rifts is an item check.
The Compass Badge can track these down for you.

options.name: ShuffleDirectorTokens
options.description:
If enabled, causes the Conductor/DJ Grooves tokens found in Chapter 2 levels to become item checks.
NOTE: This also includes the time bonus pickups from Train Rush, since the level doesn't have any tokens.

options.name: ShuffleAlpineZiplines
options.description: If enabled, Alpine's zipline paths leading to the peaks will be locked behind items.

options.name: ShuffleSubconPaintings
options.description:
If enabled, shuffle items into the pool that unlock Subcon Forest fire spirit paintings.
These items are progressive, with the order of Village-Swamp-Courtyard.

options.name: ShuffleActContracts
options.description: If enabled, shuffle Snatcher's act contracts into the pool as items

options.name: MinPonCost
options.description: The minimum number of Pons that any item in the Badge Seller's shop can cost.

options.name: MaxPonCost
options.description: The maximum number of Pons that any item in the Badge Seller's shop can cost.

options.name: BadgeSellerMinItems
options.description: The smallest number of items that the Badge Seller can have for sale.

options.name: BadgeSellerMaxItems
options.description: The largest number of items that the Badge Seller can have for sale.

options.name: LogicDifficulty
options.description:
Choose the difficulty setting for logic.
For an exhaustive list of all logic tricks for each difficulty, see this Google Doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x9VLSQ5davfx1KGamR9T0mD5h69_lDXJ6H7Gq7knJRI/edit?usp=sharing

options.name: NoPaintingSkips
options.description: If enabled, prevent Subcon fire wall skips from being in logic on higher difficulty settings.

options.name: CTRLogic
options.description: Choose how you want to logically clear Cheating the Race.

options.name: ActRandomizer
options.description:
If enabled, shuffle the game's Acts between each other.
Light will cause Time Rifts to only be shuffled amongst each other,
and Blue Time Rifts and Purple Time Rifts to be shuffled separately.

options.name: StartingChapter
options.description: Determines which chapter you will be guaranteed to be able to enter at the beginning of the game.

options.name: LowestChapterCost
options.description:
Value determining the lowest possible cost for a chapter.
Chapter costs will, progressively, be calculated based on this value (except for the final chapter).

options.name: HighestChapterCost
options.description:
Value determining the highest possible cost for a chapter.
Chapter costs will, progressively, be calculated based on this value (except for the final chapter).

options.name: ChapterCostIncrement
options.description: Lower values mean chapter costs increase slower. Higher values make the cost differences more steep.

options.name: ChapterCostMinDifference
options.description: The minimum difference between chapter costs.

options.name: FinalChapterMinCost
options.description: Minimum Time Pieces required to enter the final chapter. This is part of your goal.

options.name: FinalChapterMaxCost
options.description: Maximum Time Pieces required to enter the final chapter. This is part of your goal.

options.name: FinaleShuffle
options.description: If enabled, chapter finales will only be shuffled amongst each other in act shuffle.

options.name: ActPlando
options.description:
Plando acts onto other acts. For example, "Train Rush": "Alpine Free Roam" will place Alpine Free Roam
at Train Rush.

options.name: ActBlacklist
options.description:
Blacklist acts from being shuffled onto other acts. Multiple can be listed per act.
For example, "Barrel Battle": ["The Big Parade", "Dead Bird Studio"]
will prevent The Big Parade and Dead Bird Studio from being shuffled onto Barrel Battle.

options.name: StartWithCompassBadge
options.description:
If enabled, start with the Compass Badge. In Archipelago, the Compass Badge will track all items in the world
(instead of just Relics). Recommended if you're not familiar with where item locations are.

options.name: CompassBadgeMode
options.description:
closest - Compass Badge points to the closest item regardless of classification
important_only - Compass Badge points to progression/useful items only
important_first - Compass Badge points to progression/useful items first, then it will point to junk items

options.name: RandomizeHatOrder
options.description:
Randomize the order that hats are stitched in.
Time Stop Last will force Time Stop to be the last hat in the sequence.

options.name: YarnAvailable
options.description: How much yarn is available to collect in the item pool.

options.name: YarnCostMin
options.description: The minimum possible yarn needed to stitch a hat.

options.name: YarnCostMax
options.description: The maximum possible yarn needed to stitch a hat.

options.name: MinExtraYarn
options.description:
The minimum number of extra yarn in the item pool.
There must be at least this much more yarn over the total number of yarn needed to craft all hats.
For example, if this option's value is 10, and the total yarn needed to craft all hats is 40,
there must be at least 50 yarn in the pool.

options.name: HatItems
options.description: Removes all yarn from the pool and turns the hats into individual items instead.

options.name: UmbrellaLogic
options.description: Makes Hat Kid's default punch attack do absolutely nothing, making the Umbrella much more relevant and useful

options.name: MaxExtraTimePieces
options.description:
Maximum number of extra Time Pieces from the DLCs.
Arctic Cruise will add up to 6. Nyakuza Metro will add up to 10. The absolute maximum is 56.

options.name: YarnBalancePercent
options.description: How much (in percentage) of the yarn in the pool that will be progression balanced.

options.name: TimePieceBalancePercent
options.description: How much (in percentage) of time pieces in the pool that will be progression balanced.

options.name: EnableDLC1
options.description:
Shuffle content from The Arctic Cruise (Chapter 6) into the game. This also includes the Tour time rift.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE SEAL THE DEAL DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: Tasksanity
options.description: If enabled, Ship Shape tasks will become checks. Requires DLC1 content to be enabled.

options.name: TasksanityTaskStep
options.description: How many tasks the player must complete in Tasksanity to send a check.

options.name: TasksanityCheckCount
options.description: How many Tasksanity checks there will be in total.

options.name: ShipShapeCustomTaskGoal
options.description:
Change the number of tasks required to complete Ship Shape. If this option's value is 0, the number of tasks
required will be TasksanityTaskStep x TasksanityCheckCount, if Tasksanity is enabled. If Tasksanity is disabled,
it will use the game's default of 18.
This option will not affect Cruisin' for a Bruisin'.

options.name: ExcludeTour
options.description:
Removes the Tour time rift from the game. This option is recommended if you don't want to deal with
important levels being shuffled onto the Tour time rift, or important items being shuffled onto Tour pages
when your goal is Time's End.

options.name: EnableDLC2
options.description:
Shuffle content from Nyakuza Metro (Chapter 7) into the game.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE NYAKUZA METRO DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: MetroMinPonCost
options.description: The cheapest an item can be in any Nyakuza Metro shop. Includes ticket booths.

options.name: MetroMaxPonCost
options.description: The most expensive an item can be in any Nyakuza Metro shop. Includes ticket booths.

options.name: NyakuzaThugMinShopItems
options.description: The smallest number of items that the thugs in Nyakuza Metro can have for sale.

options.name: NyakuzaThugMaxShopItems
options.description: The largest number of items that the thugs in Nyakuza Metro can have for sale.

options.name: BaseballBat
options.description:
Replace the Umbrella with the baseball bat from Nyakuza Metro.
DLC2 content does not have to be shuffled for this option but Nyakuza Metro still needs to be installed.

options.name: NoTicketSkips
options.description:
Prevent metro gate skips from being in logic on higher difficulties.
Rush Hour option will only consider the ticket skips for Rush Hour in logic.

options.name: EnableDeathWish
options.description:
Shuffle Death Wish contracts into the game. Each contract by default will have 1 check granted upon completion.
DO NOT ENABLE THIS OPTION IF YOU DO NOT HAVE SEAL THE DEAL DLC INSTALLED!!!

options.name: DWTimePieceRequirement
options.description: How many Time Pieces that will be required to unlock Death Wish.

options.name: DWShuffle
options.description:
An alternative mode for Death Wish where each contract is unlocked one by one, in a random order.
Stamp requirements to unlock contracts is removed. Any excluded contracts will not be shuffled into the sequence.
If Seal the Deal is the end goal, it will always be the last Death Wish in the sequence.
Disabling candles is highly recommended.

options.name: DWShuffleCountMin
options.description:
The minimum number of Death Wishes that can be in the Death Wish shuffle sequence.
The final result is clamped at the number of non-excluded Death Wishes.

options.name: DWShuffleCountMax
options.description:
The maximum number of Death Wishes that can be in the Death Wish shuffle sequence.
The final result is clamped at the number of non-excluded Death Wishes.

options.name: DWEnableBonus
options.description:
In Death Wish, add a location for completing all of a DW contract's bonuses,
in addition to the location for completing the DW contract normally.
WARNING!! Only for the brave! This option can create VERY DIFFICULT SEEDS!
ONLY turn this on if you know what you are doing to yourself and everyone else in the multiworld!
Using Peace and Tranquility to auto-complete the bonuses will NOT count!

options.name: DWAutoCompleteBonuses
options.description:
If enabled, auto complete all bonus stamps after completing the main objective in a Death Wish.
This option will have no effect if bonus checks (DWEnableBonus) are turned on.

options.name: DWExcludeAnnoyingContracts
options.description:
Exclude Death Wish contracts from the pool that are particularly tedious or take a long time to reach/clear.
Excluded Death Wishes are automatically completed as soon as they are unlocked.
This option currently excludes the following contracts:
- Vault Codes in the Wind
- Boss Rush
- Camera Tourist
- The Mustache Gauntlet
- Rift Collapse: Deep Sea
- Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
- Seal the Deal (non-excluded if goal, but the checks are still excluded)

options.name: DWExcludeAnnoyingBonuses
options.description:
If Death Wish full completions are shuffled in, exclude tedious Death Wish full completions from the pool.
Excluded bonus Death Wishes automatically reward their bonus stamps upon completion of the main objective.
This option currently excludes the following bonuses:
- So You're Back From Outer Space
- Encore! Encore!
- Snatcher's Hit List
- 10 Seconds until Self-Destruct
- Killing Two Birds
- Zero Jumps
- Bird Sanctuary
- Wound-Up Windmill
- Vault Codes in the Wind
- Boss Rush
- Camera Tourist
- The Mustache Gauntlet
- Rift Collapse: Deep Sea
- Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
- Seal the Deal

options.name: DWExcludeCandles
options.description: If enabled, exclude all candle Death Wishes.

options.name: DeathWishOnly
options.description:
An alternative gameplay mode that allows you to exclusively play Death Wish in a seed.
This has the following effects:
- Death Wish is instantly unlocked from the start
- All hats and other progression items are instantly given to you
- Useful items such as Fast Hatter Badge will still be in the item pool instead of in your inventory at the start
- All chapters and their levels are unlocked, act shuffle is forced off
- Any checks other than Death Wish contracts are completely removed
- All Pons in the item pool are replaced with Health Pons or random cosmetics
- The EndGoal option is forced to complete Seal the Deal

options.name: TrapChance
options.description: The chance for any junk item in the pool to be replaced by a trap.

options.name: BabyTrapWeight
options.description:
The weight of Baby Traps in the trap pool.
Baby Traps place a multitude of the Conductor's grandkids into Hat Kid's hands, causing her to lose her balance.

options.name: LaserTrapWeight
options.description:
The weight of Laser Traps in the trap pool.
Laser Traps will spawn multiple giant lasers (from Snatcher's boss fight) at Hat Kid's location.

options.name: ParadeTrapWeight
options.description:
The weight of Parade Traps in the trap pool.
Parade Traps will summon multiple Express Band owls with knives that chase Hat Kid by mimicking her movement.

options.name: goal
options.description:
Ganon: Climb GT, defeat Agahnim 2, and then kill Ganon
Crystals: Only killing Ganon is required. However, items may still be placed in GT
Bosses: Defeat the boss of all dungeons, including Agahnim's tower and GT (Aga 2)
Pedestal: Pull the Triforce from the Master Sword pedestal
Ganon Pedestal: Pull the Master Sword pedestal, then kill Ganon
Triforce Hunt: Collect Triforce pieces spread throughout the worlds, then turn them in to Murahadala in front of Hyrule Castle
Local Triforce Hunt: Collect Triforce pieces spread throughout your world, then turn them in to Murahadala in front of Hyrule Castle
Ganon Triforce Hunt: Collect Triforce pieces spread throughout the worlds, then kill Ganon
Local Ganon Triforce Hunt: Collect Triforce pieces spread throughout your world, then kill Ganon

options.name: mode
options.description:
Standard: Begin the game by rescuing Zelda from her cell and escorting her to the Sanctuary
Open: Begin the game from your choice of Link's House or the Sanctuary
Inverted: Begin in the Dark World. The Moon Pearl is required to avoid bunny-state in Light World, and the Light World game map is altered

options.name: glitches_required
options.description:
Determine the logic required to complete the seed
None: No glitches required
Minor Glitches: Puts fake flipper, waterwalk, super bunny shenanigans, and etc into logic
Overworld Glitches: Assumes the player has knowledge of both overworld major glitches (boots clips, mirror clips) and minor glitches
Hybrid Major Glitches: In addition to overworld glitches, also requires underworld clips between dungeons.
No Logic: Your own items are placed with no regard to any logic; such as your Fire Rod can be on your Trinexx.

options.name: dark_room_logic
options.description:
Logic for unlit dark rooms. Lamp: require the Lamp for these rooms to be considered accessible.
Torches: in addition to lamp, allow the fire rod and presence of easily accessible torches for access.
None: all dark rooms are always considered doable, meaning this may force completion of rooms in complete darkness.

options.name: open_pyramid
options.description:
Determines whether the hole at the top of pyramid is open.
Goal will open the pyramid if the goal requires you to kill Ganon, without needing to kill Agahnim 2.
Auto is the same as goal except if Ganon's dropdown is in another location, the hole will be closed.

options.name: crystals_needed_for_gt
options.description: Number of crystals needed to open Ganon's Tower

options.name: crystals_needed_for_ganon
options.description: Number of crystals needed to damage Ganon

options.name: triforce_pieces_mode
options.description:
Determine how to calculate the extra available triforce pieces.
Extra: available = triforce_pieces_extra + triforce_pieces_required
Percentage: available = (triforce_pieces_percentage /100) * triforce_pieces_required
Available: available = triforce_pieces_available

options.name: triforce_pieces_percentage
options.description: Set to how many triforce pieces according to a percentage of the required ones, are available to collect in the world.

options.name: triforce_pieces_required
options.description:
Set to how many out of X triforce pieces you need to win the game in a triforce hunt.
Default is 20. Max is 90, Min is 1.

options.name: triforce_pieces_available
options.description: Set to how many triforces pieces are available to collect in the world. Default is 30. Max is 90, Min is 1

options.name: triforce_pieces_extra
options.description: Set to how many extra triforces pieces are available to collect in the world.

options.name: entrance_shuffle
options.description:
Dungeons Simple: Shuffle just dungeons amongst each other, swapping dungeons entirely, so Hyrule Castle is always 1 dungeon.
Dungeons Full: Shuffle any dungeon entrance with any dungeon interior, so Hyrule Castle can be 4 different dungeons, but keep dungeons to a specific world.
Dungeons Crossed: like dungeons_full, but allow cross-world traversal through a dungeon. Warning: May force repeated dungeon traversal.
Simple: Entrances are grouped together before being randomized. Interiors with two entrances are grouped shuffled together with each other,
and Death Mountain entrances are shuffled only on Death Mountain. Dungeons are swapped entirely.
Restricted: Like Simple, but single entrance interiors, multi entrance interiors, and Death Mountain interior entrances are all shuffled with each other.
Full: Like Restricted, but all Dungeon entrances are shuffled with all non-Dungeon entrances.
Crossed: Like Full, but interiors with multiple entrances are no longer confined to the same world, which may allow crossing worlds.
Insanity: Like Crossed, but entrances and exits may be decoupled from each other, so that leaving through an exit may not return you to the entrance you entered from.

options.name: entrance_shuffle_seed
options.description:
You can specify a number to use as an entrance shuffle seed, or a group name. Everyone with the same group name
will get the same entrance shuffle result as long as their Entrance Shuffle, Mode, Retro Caves, and Glitches
Required options are the same.

options.name: big_key_shuffle
options.description: Big Key Placement

options.name: small_key_shuffle
options.description: Small Key Placement

options.name: key_drop_shuffle
options.description:
Shuffle keys found in pots and dropped from killed enemies,
respects the small key and big key shuffle options.

options.name: compass_shuffle
options.description: Compass Placement

options.name: map_shuffle
options.description: Map Placement

options.name: restrict_dungeon_item_on_boss
options.description: Don't place dungeon-native items on the dungeon's boss.

options.name: item_pool
options.description:
Easy: Doubled upgrades, progressives, and etc. Normal:  Item availability remains unchanged from vanilla game.
Hard: Reduced upgrade availability (max: 14 hearts, blue mail, tempered sword, fire shield, no silvers unless swordless).
Expert: Minimum upgrade availability (max: 8 hearts, green mail, master sword, fighter shield, no silvers unless swordless).

options.name: item_functionality
options.description:
Easy: Allow Hammer to damage ganon, Allow Hammer tablet collection, Allow swordless medallion use everywhere.
Normal: Vanilla item functionality
Hard: Reduced helpfulness of items (potions less effective, can't catch faeries, cape uses double magic, byrna does not grant invulnerability, boomerangs do not stun, silvers disabled outside ganon)
Expert: Vastly reduces the helpfulness of items (potions barely effective, can't catch faeries, cape uses double magic, byrna does not grant invulnerability, boomerangs and hookshot do not stun, silvers disabled outside ganon)

options.name: enemy_health
options.description:
Default: Vanilla enemy HP. Easy: Enemies have reduced health. Hard: Enemies have increased health.
Expert: Enemies have greatly increased health.

options.name: enemy_damage
options.description:
Default: Vanilla enemy damage. Shuffled: 0 # Enemies deal 0 to 4 hearts and armor helps.
Chaos: Enemies deal 0 to 8 hearts and armor just reshuffles the damage.

options.name: progressive
options.description: How item types that have multiple tiers (armor, bows, gloves, shields, and swords) should be rewarded

options.name: swordless
options.description:
No swords. Curtains in Skull Woods and Agahnim's
Tower are removed, Agahnim's Tower barrier can be
destroyed with hammer. Misery Mire and Turtle Rock
can be opened without a sword. Hammer damages Ganon.
Ether and Bombos Tablet can be activated with Hammer
(and Book).

options.name: dungeon_counters
options.description:
On: Always display amount of items checked in a dungeon. Pickup: Show when compass is picked up.
Default: Show when compass is picked up if the compass itself is shuffled. Off: Never show item count in dungeons.

options.name: retro_bow
options.description: Zelda-1 like mode. You have to purchase a quiver to shoot arrows using rupees.

options.name: retro_caves
options.description:
Zelda-1 like mode. There are randomly placed take-any caves that contain one Sword and
choices of Heart Container/Blue Potion.

options.name: hints
options.description: On/Full: Put item and entrance placement hints on telepathic tiles and some NPCs, Full removes joke hints.

options.name: scams
options.description: If on, these Merchants will no longer tell you what they're selling.

options.name: boss_shuffle
options.description:
Shuffles bosses around to different locations.
Basic will shuffle all bosses except Ganon and Agahnim anywhere they can be placed.
Full chooses 3 bosses at random to be placed twice instead of Lanmolas, Moldorm, and Helmasaur.
Chaos allows any boss to appear any number of times.
Singularity places a single boss in as many places as possible, and a second boss in any remaining locations.
Supports plando placement.

options.name: pot_shuffle
options.description: Shuffle contents of pots within "supertiles" (item will still be nearby original placement).

options.name: enemy_shuffle
options.description:
Randomize every enemy spawn.
If mode is Standard, Hyrule Castle is left out (may result in visually wrong enemy sprites in that area.)

options.name: killable_thieves
options.description: Makes Thieves killable.

options.name: bush_shuffle
options.description: Randomize chance that a bush contains an enemy as well as which enemy may spawn.

options.name: shop_item_slots
options.description: Number of slots in all shops available to have items from the multiworld

options.name: randomize_shop_inventories
options.description: Generate new default inventories for overworld/underworld shops, and unique shops; or each shop independently

options.name: shuffle_shop_inventories
options.description: Shuffle default inventories of the shops around

options.name: include_witch_hut
options.description: Consider witch's hut like any other shop and shuffle/randomize it too

options.name: randomize_shop_prices
options.description: Randomize the prices of the items in shop inventories

options.name: randomize_cost_types
options.description: Prices of the items in shop inventories may cost hearts, arrow, or bombs instead of rupees

options.name: shop_price_modifier
options.description: Percentage modifier for shuffled item prices in shops

options.name: shuffle_capacity_upgrades
options.description:
Shuffle capacity upgrades into the item pool (and allow them to traverse the multiworld).
On Combined will shuffle only a single bomb upgrade and arrow upgrade each which bring you to the maximum capacity.

options.name: bombless_start
options.description: Start with a max of 0 bombs available, requiring Bomb Upgrade items in order to use bombs

options.name: shuffle_prizes
options.description: Shuffle "general" prize packs, as in enemy, tree pull, dig etc.; "bonk" prizes; or both.

options.name: tile_shuffle
options.description: Randomize flying tiles floor patterns.

options.name: misery_mire_medallion
options.description: Required medallion to open Misery Mire front entrance.

options.name: turtle_rock_medallion
options.description: Required medallion to open Turtle Rock front entrance.

options.name: glitch_boots
options.description: If this is enabled, the player will start with Pegasus Boots when playing with overworld glitches or harder logic.

options.name: beemizer_total_chance
options.description:
Percentage chance for each junk-fill item (rupees, bombs, arrows) to be
replaced with either a bee swarm trap or a single bottle-filling bee.

options.name: beemizer_trap_chance
options.description:
Percentage chance for each replaced junk-fill item to be a bee swarm
trap; all other replaced items are single bottle-filling bees.

options.name: timer
options.description:
None: No timer will be displayed. OHKO: Timer always at zero. Permanent OHKO.
Timed: Starts with clock at zero. Green clocks subtract 4 minutes (total 20). Blue clocks subtract 2 minutes (total 10). Red clocks add two minutes (total 10). Winner is the player with the lowest time at the end.
Timed OHKO: Starts the clock at ten minutes. Green clocks add five minutes (total 25). As long as the clock as at zero, Link will die in one hit.
Timed Countdown: Starts the clock with forty minutes. Same clocks as timed mode, but if the clock hits zero you lose. You can still keep playing, though.
Display: Displays a timer, but otherwise does not affect gameplay or the item pool.

options.name: countdown_start_time
options.description: For Timed OHKO and Timed Countdown timer modes, the amount of time in minutes to start with.

options.name: red_clock_time
options.description: For all timer modes, the amount of time in minutes to gain or lose when picking up a red clock.

options.name: blue_clock_time
options.description: For all timer modes, the amount of time in minutes to gain or lose when picking up a blue clock.

options.name: green_clock_time
options.description: For all timer modes, the amount of time in minutes to gain or lose when picking up a green clock.

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: allow_collect
options.description: Allows for !collect / co-op to auto-open chests containing items for other players.

options.name: ow_palettes
options.description: The type of palette shuffle to use for the overworld

options.name: uw_palettes
options.description: The type of palette shuffle to use for the underworld (caves, dungeons, etc.)

options.name: hud_palettes
options.description: The type of palette shuffle to use for the HUD

options.name: sword_palettes
options.description: The type of palette shuffle to use for the sword

options.name: shield_palettes
options.description: The type of palette shuffle to use for the shield

options.name: heartbeep
options.description: How quickly the heart beep sound effect will play

options.name: heartcolor
options.description: The color of hearts in the HUD

options.name: quickswap
options.description: Allows you to quickly swap items while playing with L/R

options.name: menuspeed
options.description: How quickly the menu appears/disappears

options.name: music
options.description: Whether background music will play in game

options.name: reduceflashing
options.description: Reduces flashing for certain scenes such as the Misery Mire and Ganon's Tower opening cutscenes

options.name: triforcehud
options.description: When and how the triforce hunt HUD should display

options.name: hard_mode
options.description:
In hard mode, the basic enemy and the final boss will have more health.
The Health Upgrades become progression, as they are now required to beat the final boss.

options.name: hammer
options.description:
Adds another item to the itempool: The Hammer.
The top middle chest will now be locked behind a breakable wall, requiring the Hammer.

options.name: extra_starting_chest
options.description: Adds an extra chest in the bottom left, making room for an extra Confetti Cannon.

options.name: start_with_one_confetti_cannon
options.description:
Start with a confetti cannon already in your inventory.
Why? Because you deserve it. You get to celebrate yourself without doing any work first.

options.name: trap_chance
options.description: Percentage chance that any given Confetti Cannon will be replaced by a Math Trap.

options.name: confetti_explosiveness
options.description: How much confetti each use of a confetti cannon will fire.

options.name: player_sprite
options.description: The sprite that the player will have.

options.name: objective
options.description:
**Kill the Creator:** Get to the final boss (the Creator) and beat all it's forms.

**Obtain secrets and kill the Creator:** like the "Kill the Creator", but need to find all three secret memories
before getting to the Creator.

**Killing the four gods:**, Beat all four enemy gods ("Fallen God", "Mithalan God", "Drunian God", "Lumerean God").

**Gods and Creator:** like "Killing the four gods" but you also have to beat the creator.

options.name: mini_bosses_to_beat
options.description:
The number of minibosses to beat before having access to the goal.

The minibosses are "Nautilus Prime", "Blaster Peg Prime", "Mergog", "Mithalan priests", "Octopus Prime",
"Crabbius Maximus", "Mantis Shrimp Prime" and "King Jellyfish God Prime".

Note that the "Energy Statue" and "Simon Says" are not minibosses.

Also note that if the objective is "killing the four enemy gods" or "Gods and creator", it might be needed to go in the abyss and
bubble cave to kill "King Jellyfish God Prime" and "Mantis Shrimp Prime".

options.name: big_bosses_to_beat
options.description:
The number of big bosses to beat before having access to the creator (the final boss).

The big bosses are "Fallen God", "Mithalan God", "Drunian God", "Lumerean God" and "The Golem".

Has no effect if the objective is "killing the four gods" or "Gods and Creator".

options.name: turtle_randomizer
options.description:
Randomize the transportation turtle.

If the objective is "killing the four gods" or "Gods and Creator", the abyss and body turtle will not be randomized.

options.name: early_energy_form
options.description:
Force the Energy form to be in a location early in the multiworld (or directly in your world if Early and Local is
selected).

options.name: early_bind_song
options.description:
Force the Bind song to be in a location early in the multiworld (or directly in your world if Early and Local is
selected).

options.name: light_needed_to_get_to_dark_places
options.description:
Make sure that the sun form or the dumbo pet can be acquired before getting to dark places.

Be aware that navigating in dark places without light is extremely difficult.

You can also force the sun form to be accessible by using the "sun form" option.

options.name: bind_song_needed_to_get_under_rock_bulb
options.description: Make sure that the bind song can be acquired before having to obtain sing bulbs under rocks.

options.name: unconfine_home_water
options.description:
Open the way out of the Home Waters area so that Naija can go to open water and beyond without the bind song.

**Via energy door:** Open the energy door between the home waters and the open waters

**Via transturtle:** Remove the rock blocking the home water transturtle.

Note that if you turn this option off, it is recommended to turn on the Early Energy form and Early Bind Song
options.

options.name: ingredient_randomizer
options.description:
Select if the simple ingredients (that do not have a recipe) should be randomized.

If "Common Ingredients" is selected, the randomization will exclude the "Red Bulb", "Special Bulb" and "Rukh Egg".

options.name: dish_randomizer
options.description: Randomize the drop of Dishes (Ingredients with recipe).

options.name: aquarian_translation
options.description: Translate the Aquarian scripture in the game into English.

options.name: skip_first_vision
options.description: Skip the first vision in the game, where Naija transforms into Energy Form and gets flooded by enemies.

options.name: blind_goal
options.description:
Hide the goal's requirements from the help page so that you don't know what is needed to goal.

Note that when you get to the final boss door (or you beat the last gods when the "Killing the four gods"
is selected) you can then see the requirements in the help page.

options.name: infinite_hot_soup
options.description:
As soon as a "hot soup" is received, the user will never run out of this dish.

This option is recommended if using Ingredient randomization since "hot soup" ingredients may become hard to get
and the "hot soup" is necessary to get to some locations.

options.name: open_body_tongue
options.description: Remove the body tongue making the body accessible without going in the sunken city

options.name: maximum_ingredient_amount
options.description: The maximum number of the same ingredients that can be stacked on the ingredient inventory.

options.name: skip_final_boss_3rd_form
options.description:
The Final boss third form (the hide and seek form) can be easy and quite long. So, this option can be used
to skip this form.

Note that you will still need to deliver the final blow to the 3rd form in order to activate the 4th form animation.

options.name: save_healing
options.description:
When you save, Naija is healed back to full health. If disabled, saving won't heal Naija.

Note that Naija can still heal by sleeping in some beds in the game (including in her home).

options.name: throne_as_location
options.description:
If enabled, sitting on the Mithalas City Castle throne (with the seal on it) will be a location and opening the
door to the Mithalas Cathedral will be an item.

options.name: no_progression_hard_or_hidden_locations
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items at hard-to-reach or hard-to-find locations.

Those locations are very High locations (that need beast form, soup and skill to get), every location in the
bubble cave, locations where need you to cross a false wall without any indication, the Arnassi race,
bosses and minibosses.

Useful for those that want a more casual run.

options.name: no_progression_simon_says
options.description: Make sure that there are no progression items in the says area.

options.name: no_progression_kelp_forest
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in Kelp Forest (excluding Simon says area).

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

options.name: no_progression_veil
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Veil.

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

options.name: no_progression_mithalas
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Mithalas (city, castle and cathedral).

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

options.name: no_progression_energy_temple
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Energy Temple.

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

options.name: no_progression_arnassi_ruins
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Arnassi Ruins.

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

Note that if the Transportation turtle are not randomize, this include Simon Says area.

options.name: no_progression_frozen_veil
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Frozen Veil (including Ice Cavern and Bubble Cave).

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

options.name: no_progression_abyss
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Abyss.

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

Has no effect if the objective is "killing the four gods".

options.name: no_progression_sunken_city
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Sunken City.

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

Has no effect if the objective is "killing the four gods".

options.name: no_progression_body
options.description:
Make sure that there are no progression items in the Body (including the before-boss transturtle room
and the boss location).

Can be useful to get smaller runs.

Has no effect if the objective is "killing the four gods".

options.name: difficulty
options.description: Adjusts the overall difficulty of the randomizer, including upgrades required to defeat bosses and advanced movement tricks or glitches.

options.name: penitence
options.description: Allows one of the three Penitences to be chosen at the beginning of the game.

options.name: starting_location
options.description:
Choose where to start the randomizer. Note that some starting locations cannot be chosen with certain other options.

Specifically, Brotherhood and Mourning And Havoc cannot be chosen if Shuffle Dash is enabled, and Grievance Ascends cannot be chosen if Shuffle Wall Climb is enabled.

options.name: ending
options.description:
Choose which ending is required to complete the game.

Talking to Tirso in Albero will tell you the selected ending for the current game.

Ending A: Collect all thorn upgrades.

Ending C: Collect all thorn upgrades and the Holy Wound of Abnegation.

options.name: thorn_shuffle
options.description: Shuffles the Thorn given by Deogracias and all Thorn upgrades into the item pool.

options.name: reliquary_shuffle
options.description: Adds the True Torment exclusive Reliquary rosary beads into the item pool.

options.name: death_link
options.description:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

Note that Guilt Fragments will not appear when killed by death link.

options.name: prie_dieu_warp
options.description: Automatically unlocks the ability to warp between Prie Dieu shrines.

options.name: skip_cutscenes
options.description: Automatically skips most cutscenes.

options.name: corpse_hints
options.description: Changes the 34 corpses in game to give various hints about item locations.

options.name: skip_long_quests
options.description:
Ensures that the rewards for long quests will be filler items.

Affected locations: "Albero: Donate 50000 Tears", "Ossuary: 11th reward", "AtTotS: Miriam's gift", "TSC: Jocinero's final reward"

options.name: start_wheel
options.description: Changes the beginning gift to The Young Mason's Wheel.

options.name: dash_shuffle
options.description: Turns the ability to dash into an item that must be found in the multiworld.

options.name: wall_climb_shuffle
options.description: Turns the ability to climb walls with your sword into an item that must be found in the multiworld.

options.name: skill_randomizer
options.description: Randomizes the abilities from the skill tree into the item pool.

options.name: boots_of_pleading
options.description:
Adds the custom relic Boots of Pleading into the item pool, which grants the ability to fall onto spikes and survive.

Must have the "Boots of Pleading" mod installed to connect to a multiworld.

options.name: purified_hand
options.description:
Adds the custom relic Purified Hand of the Nun into the item pool, which grants the ability to jump a second time in mid-air.

Must have the "Double Jump" mod installed to connect to a multiworld.

options.name: enemy_randomizer
options.description:
Randomizes the enemies that appear in each room.

Shuffled: Enemies will be shuffled amongst each other, but can only appear as many times as they do in a standard game.

Randomized: Every enemy is completely random, and can appear any number of times.

Some enemies will never be randomized.

options.name: enemy_groups
options.description:
Randomized enemies will be chosen from sets of specific groups. 

(Weak, normal, large, flying)

Has no effect if Enemy Randomizer is disabled.

options.name: enemy_scaling
options.description:
Randomized enemies will have their stats increased or decreased depending on the area they appear in.

Has no effect if Enemy Randomizer is disabled.

options.name: logic
options.description: Choose the logic used by the randomizer.

options.name: skip_intro
options.description:
Skips escaping the police station.

Graffiti spots tagged during the intro will not unlock items.

options.name: skip_dreams
options.description:
Skips the dream sequences at the end of each chapter.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: skip_statue_hands
options.description: Skips spraying the lion statue hands after the dream in Chapter 5.

options.name: total_rep
options.description:
Change the total amount of REP in your world.

At least 960 REP is needed to finish the game.

Will be rounded to the nearest number divisible by 8.

options.name: extra_rep_required
options.description: Changes the final boss to require 1000 REP instead of 960 REP to start.

options.name: starting_movestyle
options.description: Choose which movestyle to start with.

options.name: limited_graffiti
options.description:
Each graffiti design can only be used a limited number of times before being removed from your inventory.

In some cases, such as completing a dream, using graffiti to defeat enemies, or spraying over your own graffiti, uses will not be counted.

If enabled, doing graffiti is disabled during crew battles, to prevent softlocking.

options.name: small_graffiti_uses
options.description:
Choose if small graffiti should be separate, meaning that you will need to switch characters every time you run out, or combined, meaning that unlocking new characters will add 5 uses that any character can use.

Has no effect if Limited Graffiti is disabled.

options.name: skip_polo_photos
options.description: Skip taking pictures of Polo for items.

options.name: dont_save_photos
options.description:
Photos taken with the Camera app will not be saved.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: score_difficulty
options.description:
Alters the score required to win score challenges and crew battles.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: damage_multiplier
options.description:
Multiplies all damage received.

At 3x, most damage will OHKO the player, including falling into pits.
At 6x, all damage will OHKO the player.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: death_link
options.description:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: task_advances
options.description: Task Advances allow you to skip one step of a level task. They do not restock, so use them sparingly.

options.name: turners
options.description: Turners allow you to change the direction of a Bumper. These restock when the board resets.

options.name: paint_cans
options.description:
Paint Cans allow you to change the color of a Bumper.
The ones you get from the multiworld restock when the board resets; you also get one-time ones from score.

options.name: trap_count
options.description:
Traps affect the board in various ways.
This number indicates how many total traps will be added to the item pool.

options.name: rainbow_trap_weight
options.description: Rainbow Traps change the color of every bumper on the field.

options.name: spinner_trap_weight
options.description: Spinner Traps change the direction of every bumper on the field.

options.name: killer_trap_weight
options.description: Killer Traps end the current board immediately.

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: death_link_amnesty
options.description: How many deaths it takes to send a DeathLink

options.name: logic_difficulty
options.description: Whether the logic expects you to play the intended way, or to be able to use advanced tricks and skips

options.name: move_shuffle
options.description:
Whether the following base movement abilities are shuffled into the item pool:
- Ground Dash
- Air Dash
- Skid Jump
- Climb

NOTE: Having Move Shuffle and Standard Logic Difficulty will guarantee that one of the four Move items will be immediately accessible

WARNING: Combining Move Shuffle and Hard Logic Difficulty can require very difficult tricks

options.name: total_strawberries
options.description: How many Strawberries exist

options.name: strawberries_required_percentage
options.description: Percentage of existing Strawberries you must receive to finish

options.name: friendsanity
options.description: Whether chatting with your friends grants location checks

options.name: signsanity
options.description: Whether reading signs grants location checks

options.name: carsanity
options.description: Whether riding on cars grants location checks

options.name: checkpointsanity
options.description:
Whether activating Checkpoints grants location checks

Activating this will also shuffle items into the pool which allow usage and warping to each Checkpoint

options.name: madeline_one_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has one dash

The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color

A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_two_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has two dashes

The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color

A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_no_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has no dashes

The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color

A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_feather_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has a feather

The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color

A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: badeline_chaser_source
options.description:
What type of action causes more Badeline Chasers to start spawning

Locations: The number of locations you've checked contributes to Badeline Chasers

Strawberries: The number of Strawberry items you've received contributes to Badeline Chasers

options.name: badeline_chaser_frequency
options.description:
How many of the `Badeline Chaser Source` actions must occur to make each Badeline Chaser start spawning

NOTE: Choosing `0` disables Badeline Chasers entirely

WARNING: Turning on Badeline Chasers alongside Move Shuffle could result in extremely difficult situations

options.name: badeline_chaser_speed
options.description: How many seconds behind you each Badeline Chaser will be

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: death_link_amnesty
options.description: How many deaths it takes to send a DeathLink

options.name: trap_link
options.description:
Whether your received traps are linked to other players

You will also receive any linked traps from other players with Trap Link enabled,
if you have a weight above "none" set for that trap

options.name: goal_area
options.description: What Area must be cleared to gain access to the Epilogue and complete the game

options.name: lock_goal_area
options.description: Determines whether your Goal Area will be locked until you receive your required Strawberries, or only the Epilogue

options.name: goal_area_checkpointsanity
options.description: Determines whether the Checkpoints in your Goal Area will be shuffled into the item pool (if Checkpointsanity is active)

options.name: total_strawberries
options.description: Maximum number of how many Strawberries can exist

options.name: strawberries_required_percentage
options.description: Percentage of existing Strawberries you must receive to access your Goal Area (if Lock Goal Area is active) and the Epilogue

options.name: checkpointsanity
options.description: Determines whether Checkpoints will be shuffled into the item pool

options.name: binosanity
options.description: Determines whether using Binoculars sends location checks

options.name: keysanity
options.description: Determines whether individual Keys are shuffled into the item pool

options.name: gemsanity
options.description: Determines whether Summit Gems are shuffled into the item pool

options.name: carsanity
options.description: Determines whether riding on cars grants location checks

options.name: roomsanity
options.description: Determines whether entering individual rooms sends location checks

options.name: include_goldens
options.description: Determines whether collecting Golden Strawberries sends location checks

options.name: include_core
options.description: Determines whether Chapter 8 - Core Levels will be included

options.name: include_farewell
options.description: Determines how much of Chapter 9 - Farewell Level will be included

options.name: include_b_sides
options.description: Determines whether the B-Side Levels will be included

options.name: include_c_sides
options.description: Determines whether the C-Side Levels will be included

options.name: junk_fill_percentage
options.description: Replace a percentage of non-required Strawberries in the item pool with junk items

options.name: trap_fill_percentage
options.description: Replace a percentage of junk items in the item pool with random traps

options.name: trap_expiration_action
options.description: The type of action which causes traps to wear off

options.name: trap_expiration_amount
options.description: The amount of the selected Trap Expiration Action that must occur for the trap to wear off

options.name: bald_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which makes Maddy bald

options.name: literature_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes the player to read literature

options.name: stun_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which briefly stuns Maddy

options.name: invisible_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which turns Maddy invisible

options.name: fast_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which increases the game speed

options.name: slow_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which decreases the game speed

options.name: ice_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes the level to become slippery

options.name: reverse_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes the controls to be reversed

options.name: screen_flip_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes the screen to be flipped

options.name: laughter_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes Maddy to laugh uncontrollably

options.name: hiccup_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes Maddy to hiccup uncontrollably

options.name: zoom_trap_weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which causes the camera to focus on Maddy

options.name: music_shuffle
options.description:
Music shuffle type

None: No Music is shuffled

Consistent: Each music track is consistently shuffled throughout the game

Singularity: The entire game uses one song for levels

options.name: require_cassettes
options.description: Determines whether you must receive a level's Cassette Item to hear that level's music

options.name: madeline_hair_length
options.description: How long Madeline's hair is

options.name: madeline_one_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has one dash
The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color
A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_two_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has two dashes
The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color
A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_no_dash_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has no dashes
The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color
A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: madeline_feather_hair_color
options.description:
What color Madeline's hair is when she has a feather
The `any_color` option will choose a fully random color
A custom color entry may be supplied as a 6-character RGB hex color code
e.g. F542C8

options.name: progression_style
options.description:
**Districts Only**: Each tech/civic that would normally unlock a district or building now has a logical progression.
Example: TECH_BRONZE_WORKING is now PROGRESSIVE_ENCAMPMENT

**Eras and Districts**: Players will be defeated if they play until the world era advances beyond the currently unlocked maximum era.
Unlocked eras can be seen in both the tech and civic trees. Includes all progressive districts.

**None**: No progressive items will be included. This means you can get district upgrades that won't be usable until the relevant district is unlocked.

options.name: shuffle_goody_hut_rewards
options.description:
Shuffles the goody hut rewards.
Goody huts will only contain junk items and locations are checked sequentially (First goody hut gives GOODY_HUT_1, second gives GOODY_HUT_2, etc.).

options.name: boostsanity
options.description:
Boosts for Civics/Techs are location checks. Boosts can now be triggered even if the item has already been
researched.

**Note**: If a boost is dependent upon a unit that is now obsolete, you can click to toggle on/off the relevant tech in
the tech tree.

options.name: research_cost_multiplier
options.description: Multiplier for research cost of techs and civics, higher values make research more expensive.

options.name: pre_hint_items
options.description:
Controls what items from the tech/civics trees are pre-hinted for the multiworld.
**Progression**: Include Progression items in hints
**Useful**: Include Useful items in hints
**Filler**: Include Filler items in hints

options.name: hide_item_names
options.description:
Each Tech and Civic Location will have a title of 'Unrevealed' until its prereqs have been researched. Note that
hints will still be precollected if that option is enabled.

options.name: advisor_show_progression_items
options.description: If enabled, an advisor icon will be added to any location that contains a progression item.

options.name: death_link
options.description: If enabled, losing a unit will trigger a death link effect on other players in the multiworld. When a death link is received, the player will receive the effect specified in 'Death Link Effect'.

options.name: death_link_effect
options.description:
What happens when a unit dies.

**Unit Killed**: A random unit will be killed when a death link is received.

**Faith**: Faith will be decreased by the amount specified in 'Death Link Effect Percent'.

**Gold**: Gold will be decreased by the amount specified in 'Death Link Effect Percent'.

**Era Score**: Era score is decreased by 1.

options.name: death_link_effect_percent
options.description: The percentage of the effect that will be applied. Only applicable for Gold and Faith effects.

options.name: character_stages
options.description: Whether to include Reinhardt-only stages, Carrie-only stages, or both with or without branching paths at the end of Villa and Castle Center.

options.name: stage_shuffle
options.description:
Shuffles which stages appear in which stage slots.
Villa and Castle Center will never appear in any character stage slots if Character Stages is set to Both; they can only be somewhere on the main path.
Castle Keep will always be at the end of the line.

options.name: starting_stage
options.description: Which stage to start at if Stage Shuffle is turned on.

options.name: warp_order
options.description: Arranges the warps in the warp menu in whichever stage order chosen, thereby changing the order they are unlocked in.

options.name: sub_weapon_shuffle
options.description: Shuffles all sub-weapons in the game within each other in their own pool or in the main item pool.

options.name: spare_keys
options.description:
Puts an additional copy of every non-Special key item in the pool for every key item that there is.
Chance gives each key item a 50% chance of having a duplicate instead of guaranteeing one for all of them.

options.name: special1s_per_warp
options.description:
Sets how many Special1 jewels are needed per warp menu option unlock.
This will decrease until the number x 7 is less than or equal to the Total Specail1s if it isn't already.

options.name: total_special1s
options.description: Sets how many Speical1 jewels are in the pool in total.

options.name: draculas_condition
options.description:
Sets the requirement for unlocking and opening the door to Dracula's chamber.
None: No requirement. Door is unlocked from the start.
Crystal: Activate the big crystal in Castle Center's basement. Neither boss afterwards has to be defeated.
Bosses: Kill a specified number of bosses with health bars and claim their Trophies.
Specials: Find a specified number of Special2 jewels shuffled in the main item pool.

options.name: percent_special2s_required
options.description: Percentage of Special2s required to enter Dracula's chamber when Dracula's Condition is Special2s.

options.name: total_special2s
options.description: How many Speical2 jewels are in the pool in total when Dracula's Condition is Special2s.

options.name: bosses_required
options.description:
How many bosses need to be defeated to enter Dracula's chamber when Dracula's Condition is set to Bosses.
This will automatically adjust if there are fewer available bosses than the chosen number.

options.name: carrie_logic
options.description:
Adds the 2 checks inside Underground Waterway's crawlspace to the pool.
If you (and everyone else if racing the same seed) are planning to only ever play Reinhardt, don't enable this.
Can be combined with Hard Logic to include Carrie-only tricks.

options.name: hard_logic
options.description:
Properly considers sequence break tricks in logic (i.e. maze skip). Can be combined with Carrie Logic to include Carrie-only tricks.
See the Game Page for a full list of tricks and glitches that may be logically required.

options.name: multi_hit_breakables
options.description:
Adds the items that drop from the objects that break in three hits to the pool.
There are 18 of these throughout the game, adding up to 79 or 80 checks (depending on sub-weapons being shuffled anywhere or not) in total with all stages.
The game will be modified to remember exactly which of their items you've picked up instead of simply whether they were broken or not.

options.name: empty_breakables
options.description: Adds 9 check locations in the form of breakables that normally have nothing (all empty Forest coffins, etc.) and some additional Red Jewels and/or moneybags into the item pool to compensate.

options.name: lizard_locker_items
options.description:
Adds the 6 items inside Castle Center 2F's Lizard-man generators to the pool.
Picking up all of these can be a very tedious luck-based process, so they are off by default.

options.name: shopsanity
options.description:
Adds 7 one-time purchases from Renon's shop into the location pool.
After buying an item from a slot, it will revert to whatever it is in the vanilla game.

options.name: hard_item_pool
options.description: Replaces some items in the item pool with less valuable ones, to make the item pool sort of resemble Hard Mode in the PAL version.

options.name: shop_prices
options.description:
Randomizes the amount of gold each item costs in Renon's shop.
Use the Minimum and Maximum Gold Price options to control how much or how little an item can cost.

options.name: minimum_gold_price
options.description: The lowest amount of gold an item can cost in Renon's shop, divided by 100.

options.name: maximum_gold_price
options.description: The highest amount of gold an item can cost in Renon's shop, divided by 100.

options.name: post_behemoth_boss
options.description: Sets which boss is fought in the vampire triplets' room in Castle Center by which characters after defeating Behemoth.

options.name: room_of_clocks_boss
options.description: Sets which boss is fought at Room of Clocks by which characters.

options.name: renon_fight_condition
options.description: Sets the condition on which the Renon fight will trigger.

options.name: vincent_fight_condition
options.description: Sets the condition on which the vampire Vincent fight will trigger.

options.name: bad_ending_condition
options.description: Sets the condition on which the currently-controlled character's Bad Ending will trigger.

options.name: increase_item_limit
options.description: Increases the holding limit of usable items from 10 to 99 of each item.

options.name: nerf_healing_items
options.description: Decreases the amount of health healed by Roast Chickens to 25%, Roast Beefs to 50%, and Healing Kits to 80%.

options.name: loading_zone_heals
options.description:
Whether end-of-level loading zones restore health and cure status aliments or not.
Recommended off for those looking for more of a survival horror experience!

options.name: invisible_items
options.description:
Sets which items are visible in their locations and which are invisible until picked up.
'Chance' gives each item a 50/50 chance of being visible or invisible.

options.name: drop_previous_sub_weapon
options.description: When receiving a sub-weapon, the one you had before will drop behind you, so it can be taken back if desired.

options.name: permanent_powerups
options.description:
Replaces PowerUps with PermaUps, which upgrade your B weapon level permanently and will stay even after dying and/or continuing.
To compensate, only two will be in the pool overall, and they will not drop from any enemy or projectile.

options.name: ice_trap_percentage
options.description:
Replaces a percentage of junk items with Ice Traps.
These will be visibly disguised as other items, and receiving one will freeze you as if you were hit by Camilla's ice cloud attack.

options.name: ice_trap_appearance
options.description: What items Ice Traps can possibly be disguised as.

options.name: disable_time_restrictions
options.description:
Disables the restriction on every event and door that requires the current time to be within a specific range, so they can be triggered at any time.
This includes all sun/moon doors and, in the Villa, the meeting with Rosa and the fountain pillar.
The Villa coffin is not affected by this.

options.name: skip_gondolas
options.description:
Makes jumping on and activating a gondola in Tunnel instantly teleport you to the other station, thereby skipping the entire three-minute ride.
The item normally at the gondola transfer point is moved to instead be near the red gondola at its station.

options.name: skip_waterway_blocks
options.description:
Opens the door to the third switch in Underground Waterway from the start so that the jumping across floating brick platforms won't have to be done.
Shopping at the Contract on the other side of them may still be logically required if Shopsanity is on.

options.name: countdown
options.description: Displays, near the HUD clock and below the health bar, the number of unobtained progression-marked items or the total check locations remaining in the stage you are currently in.

options.name: big_toss
options.description:
Makes every non-immobilizing damage source launch you as if you got hit by Behemoth's charge.
Press A while tossed to cancel the launch momentum and avoid being thrown off ledges.
Hold Z to have all incoming damage be treated as it normally would.
Any tricks that might be possible with it are not in logic.

options.name: panther_dash
options.description:
Hold C-right at any time to sprint way faster.
Any tricks that are possible with it are not in logic and any boss fights with boss health meters, if started, are expected to be finished before leaving their arenas if Dracula's Condition is bosses.
Jumpless will prevent jumping while moving at the increased speed to make logic harder to break with it.

options.name: increase_shimmy_speed
options.description:
Increases the speed at which characters shimmy left and right while hanging on ledges.
Hold Z to use the regular speed in case it's needed to do something.

options.name: fall_guard
options.description: Removes fall damage from landing too hard. Note that falling for too long will still result in instant death.

options.name: death_link
options.description:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

Explosive: Makes received death links kill you via the Magical Nitro explosion instead of the normal death animation.

options.name: window_color_r
options.description: The red value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: window_color_g
options.description: The green value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: window_color_b
options.description: The blue value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: window_color_a
options.description: The alpha value for the background color of the text windows during gameplay.

options.name: background_music
options.description:
Randomizes or disables the music heard throughout the game.
Randomized music is split into two pools: songs that loop and songs that don't.
The "lead-in" versions of some songs will be paired accordingly.

options.name: map_lighting
options.description:
Randomizes the lighting color RGB values on every map during every time of day to be literally anything.
The colors and/or shading of the following things are affected: fog, maps, player, enemies, and some objects.

options.name: cinematic_experience
options.description: Enables an unused film reel effect on every cutscene in the game. Purely cosmetic.

options.name: completion_goal
options.description:
The goal for game completion. Can be defeating Dracula, winning in the Battle Arena, or both.
If you aren't sure which one you have while playing, select the Dash Boots in the Magic Item menu.

options.name: iron_maiden_behavior
options.description:
Sets how the iron maiden barriers blocking the entrances to Underground Gallery and Waterway will behave.
Vanilla: Vanilla behavior. Must press the button guarded by Adramelech to break them.
Start Broken: The maidens will be broken from the start.
Detonator In Pool: Adds a Maiden Detonator item in the pool that will detonate the maidens when found. Adramelech will guard an extra check.

options.name: required_last_keys
options.description: How many Last Keys are needed to open the door to the Ceremonial Room. This will lower if higher than Available Last Keys.

options.name: available_last_keys
options.description:
How many Last Keys are in the pool in total.
To see this in-game, select the Last Key in the Magic Item menu (when you have at least one) or touch the Ceremonial Room door.

options.name: required_skirmishes
options.description:
Forces a Last Key after every boss or after every boss and the Battle Arena and forces the required Last Keys to enter the Ceremonial Room to 8 or 9 for All Bosses and All Bosses And Arena respectively.
The Available and Required Last Keys options will be overridden to the respective values.

options.name: nerf_roc_wing
options.description:
Initially nerfs the Roc Wing by removing its ability to jump infinitely and reducing its jump height. You can power it back up to its vanilla behavior by obtaining the following:
Double: Allows one jump in midair, using your double jump.
Kick Boots: Restores its vanilla jump height.
Both: Enables infinite midair jumping.
Note that holding A while Roc jumping will cause you to rise slightly higher; this is accounted for in logic.

options.name: buff_ranged_familiars
options.description: Makes Familiar projectiles deal double damage to enemies.

options.name: buff_sub_weapons
options.description: Increases damage dealt by sub-weapons and item crushes in Shooter and non-Shooter Modes.

options.name: buff_shooter_strength
options.description: Increases Nathan's strength in Shooter Mode to match his strength in Vampire Killer Mode.

options.name: item_drop_randomization
options.description:
Randomizes what enemies drop what items as well as the drop rates for said items.
Bosses and candle enemies will be guaranteed to have high-tier items in all of their drop slots, and "easy" enemies (below 61 HP) will only drop low-tier items in all of theirs.
All other enemies will drop a low or mid-tier item in their common drop slot, and a low, mid, or high-tier item in their rare drop slot.
The common slot item has a 6-10% base chance of appearing, and the rare has a 3-6% chance.
If Tiered is chosen, all enemies below 144 (instead of 61) HP will be considered "easy", rare items that land on bosses will be exclusive to them, enemies with 144-369 HP will have a low-tier in its common slot and a mid-tier in its rare slot, and enemies with more than 369 HP will have a mid-tier in its common slot and a high-tier in its rare slot.
See the Game Page for more info.

options.name: ignore_cleansing
options.description: Removes the logical requirement for the Cleansing to go beyond the first Underground Waterway rooms from either of the area's sides. You may be required to brave the harmful water without it.

options.name: halve_dss_cards_placed
options.description:
Places only half of the DSS Cards in the item pool.
A valid combo that lets you freeze or petrify enemies to use as platforms will always be placed.

options.name: sub_weapon_shuffle
options.description:
Randomizes which sub-weapon candles have which sub-weapons.
The total available count of each sub-weapon will be consistent with that of the vanilla game.

options.name: early_escape_item
options.description: Ensures the chosen Catacomb escape item will be placed in a starting location within your own game, accessible with nothing.

options.name: death_link
options.description:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

Received DeathLinks will not kill you in the Battle Arena unless Arena On is chosen.

options.name: auto_run
options.description: Makes Nathan always run when pressing left or right without needing to double-tap.

options.name: dss_patch
options.description: Patches out being able to pause during the DSS startup animation and switch the cards in the menu to use any combos you don't currently have, as well as changing the element of a summon to one you don't currently have.

options.name: always_allow_speed_dash
options.description: Allows activating the speed dash combo (Pluto + Griffin) without needing the respective cards first.

options.name: pluto_griffin_air_speed
options.description: Increases Nathan's air speeds with the Pluto + Griffin combo active to be the same as his ground speeds. Anything made possible with the increased air speed is out of logic.

options.name: countdown
options.description: Displays, below and near the right side of the MP bar, the number of un-found progression/useful-marked items or the total check locations remaining in the area you are currently in.

options.name: disable_battle_arena_mp_drain
options.description: Makes the Battle Arena not drain Nathan's MP, so that DSS combos can be used like normal.

options.name: skip_dialogues
options.description: Skips all cutscene dialogue besides the ending.

options.name: skip_tutorials
options.description: Skips all Magic Item and DSS-related tutorial textboxes.

options.name: battle_arena_music
options.description: Enables any looping song from the game to play inside the Battle Arena instead of it being silent the whole time.

options.name: dk_coins_for_gyrocopter
options.description:
How many DK Coins are needed to unlock the Gyrocopter

Note: Achieving this number before unlocking the Turbo Ski will cause the game to grant you a
one-time upgrade to the next non-unlocked boat, until you return to Funky. Logic does not assume
that you will use this.

options.name: kongsanity
options.description: Whether collecting all four KONG letters in each level grants a check

options.name: level_shuffle
options.description: Whether levels are shuffled

options.name: difficulty
options.description:
Which Difficulty Level to use

NORML: The Normal Difficulty
HARDR: Many DK Barrels are removed
TUFST: Most DK Barrels and all Midway Barrels are removed

options.name: goal
options.description:
Determines the goal of the seed

Knautilus: Scuttle the Knautilus in Krematoa and defeat Baron K. Roolenstein

Banana Bird Hunt: Find a certain number of Banana Birds and rescue their mother

options.name: krematoa_bonus_coin_cost
options.description: How many Bonus Coins are needed to unlock each level in Krematoa

options.name: percentage_of_extra_bonus_coins
options.description: What Percentage of unneeded Bonus Coins are included in the item pool

options.name: number_of_banana_birds
options.description: How many Banana Birds are put into the item pool

options.name: percentage_of_banana_birds
options.description: What Percentage of Banana Birds in the item pool are required for Banana Bird Hunt

options.name: autosave
options.description: Whether the game should autosave after each level

options.name: merry
options.description: Whether the Bonus Barrels will be Christmas-themed

options.name: music_shuffle
options.description: Whether music is shuffled

options.name: kong_palette_swap
options.description: Which Palette to use for the Kongs

options.name: starting_life_count
options.description: How many extra lives to start the game with

options.name: campaign
options.description: Which campaign you want to play

options.name: item_shuffle
options.description: Should Inventory Items be separate from their DLCs and shuffled in the item pool

options.name: coinsanity
options.description:
Whether collecting coins are checks
If none, you will collect your own coins

options.name: ending_choice
options.description: Which ending is considered completion for the DLC Quest campaign, either any ending or the true ending

options.name: permanent_coins
options.description: If purchasing a pack decreases your current coins amounts.

options.name: coinbundlequantity
options.description:
This is the amount of coins in a coin bundle
You need to collect that number of coins to get a location check, and when receiving coin items, you will get bundles of this size
